priorityList: Maintain Vampiric Blood at all times for maximum survivability.
Use Dancing Rune Weapon as your primary offensive and defensive cooldown.
Maintain at least 6 stacks of Bone Shield using Marrowrend or Death's Caress.
Use Death Strike to refresh the Coagulopathy buff if it is about to expire.
During Gift of the San'layn, prioritize Heart Strike to maintain Essence of the Blood Queen stacks (up to 7) and duration.
During Gift of the San'layn, use Death Strike to spend Runic Power if the deficit is less than 36.
Cast Death and Decay whenever Crimson Scourge procs to enable Heart Strike cleave in AoE.
Use Heart Strike whenever the Vampiric Strike proc is available.
Use Death Strike to prevent Runic Power capping if the deficit is less than 20.
Use Blood Boil to maintain Blood Plague or to trigger Boiling Point echoes when the buff is active.
Use Consumption as an empowered filler ability.
Use Heart Strike as your primary rune spender when you have 2 or more runes available.
Use Blood Boil as a filler for AoE damage and threat generation.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities, ideally while Dancing Rune Weapon is on cooldown.
Keep Raise Dead active at all times.
